label: Today You Will Learn
h: How to tell proportionate preparation from living in an imagined future, and sort one concern into Today, Later or Release for now.
body:
About 8 minutes, plus one short pause · one small practice · no homework list

If tomorrow holds a real hardship — money that will not stretch, housing that is not secure, a situation where you are not safe — seeking help from a debt adviser, housing service, doctor, solicitor or abuse service is preparation of the wisest kind.

label: Key Scripture
h: "Look at the birds of the air: they neither sow nor reap nor gather into barns, and yet your heavenly Father feeds them. Are you not of more value than they?"

label: Meet Philip
h: "I've prepared for the same thing forty times, and I'm no more ready than the first night. I'm just more frightened."

label: Preparing, Or Living In Tomorrow?
body:
Moves towards a resultA decision, a plan, a question, a next step.
Has an endThe future has no edge; living in it never finishes.
Works with what is establishedThe restructuring was. The loss of his role was not.
Leaves a next stepAfter forty rehearsals he knew what he would feel, not what he would do.
May include emotionBut does not consist of it.

label: A Common Belief
h: "If I really trusted God, I would not think about tomorrow at all."
body: Jesus is not forbidding thought about the future. He is forbidding a particular relationship to it: taking up tomorrow's trouble as though it were already today's.

label: First, The Check
body: Abuse, violence, stalking, imminent homelessness, a medical symptom that should not wait, a child at risk. That item goes to the top of the page. Seek safety or qualified help now.

label: The Tool · Then Sort Into Three
body:
TodayA genuine responsibility that exists now and can be acted on. Act, or seek help. Then stop.
LaterWill need action, but not yet. Write it down with the point at which it becomes today's.
Release for nowNot presently actionable. Release from mental work today, not a verdict for ever.

label: Three Cautions About Sorting Honestly
body:
Do not use "later" to avoid what belongs to today.
Do not use "release" to avoid "seek help".
Do not measure the sorting by how you feel afterwards.

label: Do This Now
h: Take the tomorrow you have been living in. Run the urgency check. Then write three short columns: Today, Later, Release for now.
body:
Then do one Today item, or schedule it. If Today is empty, return to one ordinary part of the day you are actually in.

label: Prayer
body:
Father, you feed the birds,
and I am worth more than they.

Here is what is today's.
Here is what is later.

The rest I give back to you, for now.

Amen.
